sloka: तथा ह्यसति सम्मोहे हृदयम् सीदतीव मे ।विषण्णः शान्तहृदयस्त्रस्तः सुलुलितेन्द्रियः ॥२-७१-३२॥
transliteration: tathā hyasati sammohe hṛdayam sīdatīva me ।viṣaṇṇaḥ śāntahṛdayastrastaḥ sululitendriyaḥ ॥2-71-32॥

translations.english: ﻿ Dejected and depressed at heart, with no control over his senses and his mind full of apprehension, Bharata swiftly entered the city of Ayodhya ruled by the Ikshvakus.
